history_summary: Add the species-reference GTDB correspondence for the existing Klebsiella oxytoca DX-3 descriptor
history_details: The exact species-ID route reports 855 reference genomes and rounded fraction 0.85, without assigning a genome to experimental stock DX-3. Preserve Delftia YP-3 and its two ambiguous options, source stock identities, batch versus sludge contexts and all biological claims. Native serialization only normalizes key order in the unchanged Delftia descriptor. The selected Klebsiella block/status and two native inline events are the substantive changes. Scoped database and provenance correction; retained scientific issues and corpus QC remain separate.
